New Year's Day. On our way back from the 
shrine visit, at her invitation, we came 
to the park to see the daffodils.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I look at a pure white blossom 
blooming with dignity, I feel a strength 
that refuses to succumb to winter's chill.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"It cleanses the soul. Seeing it on New 
Year's makes it even more special..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
It gives me the courage to do my best 
again this year.

"After pausing here and there to 
thoroughly admire the daffodils, we 
decided to take a break at a cafe."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
――! As expected of the famous pancakes. 
They're so fluffy...!

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text: Almond Eye really is amazing!

text_block_list.name: Man B
text_block_list.text:
First she grabs the Triple Tiara, and then 
she tears it up in the Japan Cup. I 
honestly thought I was dreaming.

In late November, at the Japan Cup, a GⅠ 
race where fierce competitors gathered 
from both home and abroad, Almond Eye—

She achieved the miraculous feat of 
setting a world record for 2400m on 
turf—in other words, clocking the fastest 
officially recorded 2400m time in the 
entire world.

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe she was still in the 
Classic Class back then! I'm so excited to 
see what she'll do in the Senior Class 
this year!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ... As expected of you, Ai-san.

text_block_list.name: Woman B
text_block_list.text:
—I mean, I don't know if it's the Almond 
Eye effect or what, but it feels like the 
Tiara route is getting a ton of attention 
this year~

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
That miler girl... Gran Alegria, was it? 
She won a graded race in just her second 
start after debuting.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
The Oka Sho is the grand stage for 
milers—so naturally, the winner will be 
me.

—An Umamusume with a fierce devotion to 
the mile. In fact, she excels at mile 
races and was considered a top contender 
to win the December mile race.

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
Like Chrono Genesis. Two straight wins 
since her debut, then 2nd in a GⅠ. Her 
burst of speed is incredible.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
First, we will continue fine-tuning for 
the Oka Sho. At this rate, achieving the 
Triple Tiara... should be well within our 
grasp.

At the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies in 
December, she made headlines with a 
tremendous burst of speed down the final 
straight.

text_block_list.name: Man B
text_block_list.text:
And then, Loves Only You! A prodigy whose 
great sense and immense talent have drawn 
attention since her debut!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"This second win is all thanks to 
everyone's support. I'll do my best in the 
Oka Sho too, okay?♡"

—A cheerful Umamusume who streams 
regularly. Despite racing from the back of 
the pack in November's Pre-OP race, she 
clinched victory with a magnificent 
straightaway burst.

text_block_list.name: Woman B
text_block_list.text:
There's quite an interesting lineup 
gathered. It's like the dawn of a Great 
Tiara Era!

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's a bit of an exaggeration for 
now! But still, you can't help but get 
your hopes up...

For a while after that, conversations 
about this year's races were endless. But 
in the end—

Over there, there's a petting zoo with 
small animals and a general store.

text_block_list.text: If you'd like, would you like to go?

Just as she said, countless shops were 
lined up. All of them looked charming, 
with a lively atmosphere. ...And yet, I 
couldn't help but wonder.

might quietly be feeling down.

heart...

Haaah— I can still feel the warmth in this

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
The rabbits, too... are living their lives 
with all their might, aren't they.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
You can't wait for those delicious spring 
dandelions you love so much, can you? 
Little bunny.

sleep-inducing benefits.

text_block_list.text:
For a while, I used to brew tea using

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or

text_block_list.text: Maybe I'll try making it in the dorm too.

Fufu, understood. I can see some with

New Year decorations—there are so many of

Putting our heads together, we pick out

This decorative rake has such gorgeous

text_block_list.text:
Love me♡ Love you♡ This was Loves Only

text_block_list.text:
—Alrighty♪ Gran-chan, thank you so much

community members were all so happy, too.

text_block_list.text:
No, if anything, I'm the one who got a

Maybe I'm overthinking it, but whenever I 
consider Curren Bouquetd'or's feelings, my 
heart still aches a little.

text_block_list.text:
...Wait, what!? Bouquet-san and the 
others!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Oho, off to the park with your Trainer, 
huh? Still, color me surprised to the tune 
of twenty miles!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. When it comes to this, I can't help 
but think how nice it'd be if Chrono-chan 
were here too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Especially this year, it seems the four of 
us will be seeing a lot of each other 
along the Tiara route.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I've heard about everyone's achievements 
in many places. That is precisely whyâ

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I am truly looking forward to chasing 
victory together and clashing with all our 
might.

I blinked at her gallant, radiant smile— 
and I wasn't the only one.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"...Ahha! Bouquet-san, that's awesome! So 
cool, like a 'bring it on!' vibe!"

little bit, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for today. And―just 
one last thing.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ever since the park... I've caused you so 
much worry, haven't I?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
However, right now... I am running true to 
myself, striving to claim the single 
blossom of victory.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
At first, they may only be small flowers. 
However, one day, I promise to hold a 
magnificent blossom in my hands.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Like a daffodil braving the bitter cold, I 
will run through with unyielding 
strength――and I will bloom, without fail.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: "So please, don't worry about me at all."

—Giving a slight bow, she walked off into 
the dorm. I watched her back as she left, 
unable to say a word.

I instinctively straightened my posture. 
She was growing, step by step.

Then I must not fall behind either, and 
support her throughout this entire year.
